# Kavach Vault

> A QoreChain vault where a stolen classical key moves nothing. Every withdrawal needs an ML-DSA-87 signature from the owner's post-quantum key, checked on chain with pqcVerify; the caller's address grants nothing. Entered in the Q-Day Drill (18 Nov 2026): only our proof of life left the drill account, 1 QOR before and after (100% kept).

Start with JUDGES.md: each claim there links to its proof. Machine-readable claims: evidence/summary.json.

## Review first
- [JUDGES.md](JUDGES.md): the drill criterion by criterion, what we did differently, how to verify live, limits
- [evidence/summary.json](evidence/summary.json): addresses, proof of life, predictions, claims with evidence paths
- [docs/12-DRILL-PREDICTIONS.md](docs/12-DRILL-PREDICTIONS.md): predicted outcome of every attack, written during the drill before the attack log was published

## Proofs
- [evidence/post-drill.json](evidence/post-drill.json): chain state after the drill (reproduce with `node scripts/verify-drill.mjs`)
- [evidence/proof-of-life.json](evidence/proof-of-life.json): the drill-day transaction (code 0, sender = drill account, 00:01:03 UTC)
- [evidence/attack-log.json](evidence/attack-log.json): 298 native, 34 EVM and 78 vault-call attacks before the drill, 0 accepted
- [evidence/watchtower-test.json](evidence/watchtower-test.json): automatic guardian freeze tested
- [SECURITY-PROOFS.md](SECURITY-PROOFS.md): each security claim with the test that checks it
